First, 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 4 days → total added = 340 days.  

Start date: 1184-06-30 (Gregorian calendar).  
1184 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400 — 1184 not a century year).  
From 1184-06-30, remaining days in 1184:  
July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 → total = 184 days left in 1184.  

340 − 184 = 156 days into 1185.  
1185 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31 = 151 days (31+28+31+30+31).  
156 − 151 = 5 days into June.  

So new date = 1185-06-05.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1185-06-05
